# Import the data
```{r}
# Import the longtable with all results
lt <- read.csv(file="../data/qual_longtable.csv")
lt$Postcondition <- factor(lt$Postcondition, 
                            levels = c(0, 1), 
                            labels = c("incorrect", "correct"), 
                            ordered = FALSE)
lt$Assessment <- factor(lt$Assessment, 
                            levels = c(0, 1), 
                            labels = c("incorrect", "correct"), 
                            ordered = FALSE)

```

# Relationships
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(networkD3)

approach_cols <- c("Pos.Example", "Neg.Example", 
                   "Clause.Compare", "Logic.Walk", "Intuition")

df_long <- lt %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(approach_cols), 
               names_to = "Approach", 
               values_to = "Used") %>%
  filter(Used == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    Postcondition.Label = ifelse(Postcondition == "correct", "Postcondition_Correct", "Postcondition_Incorrect"),
    Assessment.Label    = ifelse(Assessment == "correct", "Perceived_Correct", "Perceived_Incorrect"),
  )
# Postcondition Correct
df_post_correct <- df_long %>% filter(Postcondition == "correct")

# Postcondition Incorrect  
df_post_incorrect <- df_long %>% filter(Postcondition == "incorrect")
```


# Sankeys
```{r}
make_links <- function(data, from_col, to_col) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(from_col, to_col)))) %>%
    summarise(value = n_distinct(Pid), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(source = 1, target = 2)
}


build_sankey <- function(df) {
  links_2 <- bind_rows(
    make_links(df, "Approach", "Assessment.Label")
  ) %>%
    mutate(link_group = source) %>%
    mutate(value = value / sum(value) * 100)  # normalize to percentages

  nodes_2 <- data.frame(name = unique(c(links_2$source, links_2$target))) %>%
    mutate(name = gsub("^fn_|^mm_", "", name))

  approach_order <- c("Clause.Compare", "Logic.Walk", "Pos.Example", "Neg.Example", "Intuition")
  left_nodes   <- nodes_2$name[nodes_2$name %in% c("Postcondition_Correct", "Postcondition_Incorrect")]
  middle_nodes <- approach_order
  right_nodes  <- nodes_2$name[!nodes_2$name %in% c(left_nodes, middle_nodes)]
  nodes_2 <- data.frame(name = c(left_nodes, middle_nodes, right_nodes))

  node_colors_2 <- nodes_2 %>%
    mutate(color = case_when(
      name == "Postcondition_Correct"   ~ "#534AB7",
      name == "Postcondition_Incorrect" ~ "#CECBF6",
      name == "Perceived_Correct"       ~ "#1D9E75",
      name == "Perceived_Incorrect"     ~ "#D85A30",
      name == "Pos.Example"             ~ "#5DCAA5",
      name == "Neg.Example"             ~ "#F0997B",
      name == "Clause.Compare"          ~ "#85B7EB",
      name == "Logic.Walk"              ~ "#FAC775",
      name == "Intuition"               ~ "#ED93B1",
      TRUE                              ~ "#888780"
    ))


  display_names <- gsub("\\.", " ", gsub("_", " ", node_colors_2$name))
  color_scale_2 <- paste0(
    'd3.scaleOrdinal().domain([',
    paste0('"', display_names, '"', collapse = ','),
    ']).range([',
    paste0('"', node_colors_2$color, '"', collapse = ','),
    '])'
  )

  links_2$source    <- match(links_2$source, nodes_2$name) - 1
  links_2$target    <- match(links_2$target, nodes_2$name) - 1
  links_2$link_group <- gsub("Postcondition ", "", gsub("\\.", " ", gsub("_", " ", links_2$link_group)))

  nodes_display <- nodes_2 %>%
    mutate(name = gsub("Postcondition ", "", gsub("\\.", " ", gsub("_", " ", name))))

  sankeyNetwork(Links = links_2, Nodes = nodes_display,
                Source = "source", Target = "target",
                Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
                LinkGroup = "link_group",
                fontSize = 40, nodeWidth = 150,
                width = 960, height = 500,
                colourScale = networkD3::JS(color_scale_2),
                sinksRight = TRUE,
                iterations = 0) %>%
    htmlwidgets::onRender("
      function(el) {
        // Stretch the right column so its first and last nodes line up with the top and bottom of the left column
        // (the sankey layout uses one padding for every column, so a 2-node column ends short of a 5-node one).
        var nodeData = d3.select(el).selectAll('.node').data();
        var maxX = d3.max(nodeData, function(d) { return d.x; });
        var left = nodeData.filter(function(d) { return d.x < maxX; });
        var right = nodeData.filter(function(d) { return d.x === maxX; }).sort(function(a, b) { return a.y - b.y; });
        if (left.length && right.length > 1) {
          var top = d3.min(left, function(d) { return d.y; });
          var bottom = d3.max(left, function(d) { return d.y + d.dy; });
          var gap = (bottom - top - d3.sum(right, function(d) { return d.dy; })) / (right.length - 1), y = top;
          right.forEach(function(d) { d.y = y; y += d.dy + gap; });
          d3.select(el).selectAll('.node').attr('transform', function(d) { return 'translate(' + d.x + ',' + d.y + ')'; });
          d3.select(el).selectAll('.link').attr('d', function(d) {   // redraw the links from the moved node positions
            var x0 = d.source.x + d.source.dx, x1 = d.target.x, xm = (x0 + x1) / 2;
            var y0 = d.source.y + d.sy + d.dy / 2, y1 = d.target.y + d.ty + d.dy / 2;
            return 'M' + x0 + ',' + y0 + 'C' + xm + ',' + y0 + ' ' + xm + ',' + y1 + ' ' + x1 + ',' + y1;
          });
        }
        d3.selectAll('.node text')
          .style('font-weight', 'bold')
          .style('font-size', '0');
        d3.selectAll('.node').each(function(d) {
          var nodeHeight = d3.select(this).select('rect').attr('height');
          var nodeWidth = 150; // match your nodeWidth parameter
          var parts = d.name.split(' ');
          var noSplit = ['Pos Example', 'Neg Example'];
          var parts = d.name.split(' ');
          if (parts.length > 1 && noSplit.indexOf(d.name) === -1) {
            d3.select(this).append('text')
              .attr('x', nodeWidth / 2)
              .attr('y', nodeHeight / 2)
              .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
              .style('font-size', '22px')
              .style('font-family', 'Times, serif')
              .style('font-weight', 'bold')
              .style('fill', 'black')
              .style('pointer-events', 'none')
              .append('tspan')
                .attr('x', nodeWidth / 2)
                .attr('dy', '-0.3em')
                .text(parts[0])
              .select(function() { return this.parentNode; })
              .append('tspan')
                .attr('x', nodeWidth / 2)
                .attr('dy', '1.2em')
                .text(parts[1]);
          } else {
            d3.select(this).append('text')
              .attr('x', nodeWidth / 2)
              .attr('y', nodeHeight / 2)
              .attr('dy', '0.35em')
              .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
              .style('font-size', '22px')
              .style('font-family', 'Times, serif')
              .style('font-weight', 'bold')
              .style('fill', 'black')
              .style('pointer-events', 'none')
              .text(d.name);
          }
        });


        var forceColors = {
          'Perceived Correct':  '#1D9E75',
          'Perceived Incorrect': '#D85A30'
        };
        d3.selectAll('.node').each(function(d) {
          if (forceColors[d.name]) {
            d3.select(this).select('rect').style('fill', forceColors[d.name]);
          }
        });
      }
    ")
}
sankey_incorrect_percep <- build_sankey(df_post_incorrect)
sankey_correct_percep   <- build_sankey(df_post_correct)
```

```{r sankey-figure, fig.cap="Strategies used (middle) by how participants assessed the postcondition (right), for ground-truth correct and incorrect postconditions.", out.width="85%", fig.align="center"}
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::tagList(sankey_correct_percep, sankey_incorrect_percep)        
} else {
  shot <- function(w) { html <- tempfile(fileext = ".html"); png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    htmlwidgets::saveWidget(w, html, selfcontained = TRUE)
    webshot::webshot(html, png, vwidth = 960, vheight = 500, delay = 1, zoom = 3); png::readPNG(png) }
  panels <- list(a = shot(sankey_correct_percep), b = shot(sankey_incorrect_percep))
  out <- Sys.getenv("SANKEY_PDF", tempfile(fileext = ".pdf"))
  pdf(out, width = 9.6, height = 10.6)
  grid::grid.newpage()
  for (i in 1:2) {
    vp <- grid::viewport(y = c(0.75, 0.25)[i], height = 0.5)
    grid::pushViewport(vp)
    grid::grid.raster(panels[[i]], y = 0.46, height = 0.86, interpolate = TRUE)
    grid::grid.text(c("Original Postcondition - Correct", "Original Postcondition - Incorrect")[i], x = 0.5, y = 0.975, just = c("centre", "top"),
                    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 22, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "serif"))
    grid::popViewport()
  }
  grid::grid.lines(x = c(0, 1), y = c(0.5, 0.5), gp = grid::gpar(lwd = 3))   
  invisible(dev.off())
  knitr::include_graphics(out)
}
```
